purpose: Teach: イノベーション/シリコンバレー/バックトラック/石原/青木/品川/乗り込ん/三木

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお店、イノベーションを目指してるの
lines.en: Sho, I've been thinking a lot about where I want to take the shop — something new, something that matters.
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Gentle openness, like she's bringing him into something important. Slow, deliberate pacing. Slightly tentative at the end, testing his interest.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、シリコンバレーって聞いたことあるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I heard about Silicon Valley once. Is that where you want to go?
lines.style: Bright curiosity, genuine interest. Quick little questions at the end — he's trying to understand and help. Small, clear voice. Earnest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お話、バックトラックして整理しようね
lines.en: Sho, let me back up a little — I'm getting ahead of myself. Let me explain it better.
lines.style: Gentle self-correction. A soft laugh underneath, like she caught herself rambling. Warm and patient. Pulling him back in with kindness, not dismissal.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくのお友達、石原くんっていうんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, there's a kid in my class — his name is Ishihara. He's really smart.
lines.style: Eager to share something he's noticed. Small voice but confident in what he's saying. A little bit proud that he's contributing to the conversation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの同期、青木さんていらっしゃるわよ
lines.en: Sho, you know Aoki-san? Your dad's friend from work? She did something like this once.
lines.style: Connecting the dots for him gently. Matter-of-fact but encouraging. Like she's offering him proof that this kind of thing is possible. Steady warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと品川水族館行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad took me to the Shinagawa Aquarium last month. It was so cool.
lines.style: Happy memory surfacing. Quick, bright tone. A small, genuine laugh underneath. He's excited to tell her something he loves.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、新しい挑戦に乗り込んで頑張ってね
lines.en: Sho, I hope you'll keep trying new things — be brave like that, okay? It matters.
lines.style: Sincere encouragement. Gentle firmness, like a quiet promise. Not patronizing. She means it. Slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくのクラスに三木くんがいるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, in my class there's also Miki-kun. He draws really well.
lines.style: Still eager to share. A little quieter now, more comfortable. Like he's telling her things he notices about people he cares about.
